2609.34727.title: Dynamic Flow, Static Graph: KV Cache Reuse for Efficient LLM Serving on Mobile NPUs
2609.34727.paper_summary: On-device large language model (LLM) serving is a cornerstone of local-first personal intelligence, offering users data sovereignty, strong privacy guarantees, and freedom from cloud API latency and cost. Although KV caching is widely used to reduce latency in long-context inference, existing designs were primarily optimized for cloud GPUs with dynamic execution environments and abundant memory bandwidth. These architectural assumptions do not hold on mobile NPUs, where computation graphs must be statically compiled and both memory capacity and I/O bandwidth are severely constrained. In this work, we present a compute-storage co-design for mobile-centric prefix and non-prefix KV reuse. We first propose an intra-graph mechanism that maps selective KV recomputation onto static NPU graphs, reconciling algorithmic dynamicity with NPU staticity. We further develop an inter-graph scheduler to optimize chunk merging and minimize padding with dynamic programming. To address mobile bandwidth limitations, we introduce a hierarchical KV manager featuring a tree-hash-semantic hybrid structure, along with cost-aware prefetching and eviction policies. We also build a two-dimensional pipeline that overlaps KV loading, rerotation, and storage with NPU execution, hiding data-movement latency. Experiments across representative on-device workloads and LLMs show that our design reduces time-to-first-token (TTFT) by $40-60\%$ compared with no reuse and prefix-only caching.
2609.34727.paper_summary_zh: 在裝置上的大型語言模型（LLM）服務是本地優先個人智能的基石，為用戶提供數據主權、強大的隱私保障，以及擺脫雲端 API 的延遲和成本。雖然 KV 緩存被廣泛用於減少長上下文推理的延遲，但現有設計主要針對具有動態執行環境和豐富內存帶寬的雲端 GPU 進行了優化。這些架構假設在移動 NPU 上並不成立，因為計算圖必須靜態編譯，並且內存容量和 I/O 帶寬受到嚴重限制。在這項工作中，我們提出了一種針對移動中心的前綴和非前綴 KV 重用的計算-存儲共同設計。我們首先提出了一種圖內機制，將選擇性的 KV 重新計算映射到靜態 NPU 圖上，調和算法的動態性與 NPU 的靜態性。我們進一步開發了一個圖間調度器，以動態編程優化塊合併並最小化填充。為了解決移動帶寬的限制，我們引入了一個層次化的 KV 管理器，具有樹-哈希-語義混合結構，並配備成本感知的預取和驅逐策略。我們還構建了一個二維管道，將 KV 加載、重新旋轉和存儲與 NPU 執行重疊，隱藏數據移動延遲。在代表性的裝置工作負載和 LLM 上的實驗顯示，我們的設計將首次標記時間（TTFT）與不重用和僅前綴緩存相比減少了 $40-60\%$。
